item.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Patch Notes
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was October's biggest game in the US, but it wasn't enough to crack 2026's best-selling top 10
item.description: Despite its somewhat muted critical reception, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has predictably topped the US video game charts in October. The Infinity Ward -developed shooter was October's best-selling game in the US across digital and retail, beating the month's other big-hitters, including Gears of War: E-Day and Star Wars: Galactic Racer.
